note.text: Diagnosed 6 years ago. Two relapses in the past 3 years. Currently on natalizumab (Tysabri) IV infusion every 4 weeks. JC virus antibody positive — risk stratification ongoing.
Fatigue Impact Scale score 62/84. Managed with amantadine and structured rest periods. Occupational therapy referral in place.
Urinary urgency and incomplete emptying. Managed with solifenacin 5mg daily and timed voiding schedule. Urology review every 6 months.
Presenting symptom at diagnosis. Treated with IV methylprednisolone. Vision recovered to near-baseline.

resource.title: MS Disease-Modifying Therapy and Symptom Management Plan
resource.description: Continuation of natalizumab therapy with quarterly MRI surveillance and annual JC virus antibody index monitoring. Symptom management for fatigue and bladder dysfunction. Physiotherapy and occupational therapy support.

detail.description: Natalizumab 300mg IV infusion every 4 weeks — next infusion in 3 weeks
Brain and spinal cord MRI with contrast every 6 months — surveillance for new lesions or PML
Annual JC virus antibody index — current index 2.1, discuss therapy switch if index rises further
Physiotherapy — core strengthening and balance exercises twice weekly
Neuropsychology assessment in 2 months to screen for cognitive changes

goal.display: Prevent further relapses and new MRI lesion activity
Reduce fatigue impact to allow continued employment and daily activities
Minimise risk of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML)
